description: This file defines a composable UI component 'ChatMarkdown' for rendering Markdown-formatted text within a chat interface using Jetpack Compose. It includes parsing Markdown, rendering various block types (paragraphs, headings, code blocks, lists, tables, etc.), and handling embedded images (including data URLs).

classes.name: InlineStyles
classes.description: Data class encapsulating styles for inline syntax elements like code and links.

classes.name: TableRenderRow
classes.description: Data class representing a row in a table, indicating whether it's a header and containing its cells.

classes.name: ParsedDataImage
classes.description: Data class for representing a parsed embedded data URL image, including MIME type and base64 data.

methods.name: ChatMarkdown
methods.description: Main composable function that takes Markdown text and renders formatted chat content.

methods.name: RenderMarkdownBlocks
methods.description: Recursive function that renders different Markdown block nodes into UI.

methods.name: RenderParagraph
methods.description: Renders paragraph nodes, including inline images.

methods.name: RenderListItem
methods.description: Renders individual list items, with support for task list markers.

methods.name: RenderTableBlock
methods.description: Renders table nodes, including headers and rows.

methods.name: buildTableRows
methods.description: Builds a list of table rows from table section nodes.

methods.name: readTableSection
methods.description: Reads table section nodes and constructs row data.

methods.name: readTableRow
methods.description: Parses individual table row nodes into cell data.

methods.name: buildInlineMarkdown
methods.description: Builds an annotated string with inline node styles from Markdown nodes.

methods.name: appendInlineNode
methods.description: Recursively appends styled inline nodes to an annotated string.

methods.name: buildPlainText
methods.description: Extracts plain text from Markdown nodes.

methods.name: standaloneDataImage
methods.description: Checks if a paragraph contains a standalone embedded data URL image.

methods.name: parseDataImageDestination
methods.description: Parses a data URL string and extracts MIME type and base64 data.

methods.name: headingStyle
methods.description: Returns a TextStyle based on heading level.

methods.name: rememberBase64ImageState
methods.description: Remembers the image loading state for a base64-encoded image.

methods.name: InlineBase64Image
methods.description: Renders a base64-encoded inline image if available, or fallback text if failed.
